reuse.why: Extends the existing shared getScheduledAmount and reuses the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules instead of re-deriving the 7.5% tolerance; schedule-template drops its own isbetween/midpoint special case in favour of the shared helper and the API uses it for expectedAmount.

duplication.why: No duplicated logic; the only repetition is the `getScheduledAmount(x, false, op)` call pattern threaded through about a dozen call sites.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the existing amount helpers, the API field is added in the API handler with a dedicated list entity type in api-models.

scope.why: Focused on the amount rule and the API field; minor leftovers such as two release notes with the first now contradicting the final rule and a stale 'far end of a range' type comment.

maintainability.why: One definition decides the expected amount for every path, but the new op argument sits behind a positional boolean (`false, op`) at every caller and stale comments (Balance 'calculate the average', api-models 'far end') remain.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All consumers, including the budget schedule template that previously special-cased isbetween, go through getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; approx tolerance delegates to getApproxNumberThreshold.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains one `op` parameter (a real variation: approximate amounts); its body is a clean range/approx/single dispatch; no call site bypasses it, and schedule-template's former bypass was removed.
